_about: Quest hubs, 17 Nov 2026: Bloodmoon Village is its own map and the isle's quest-givers stand in it, so these accept lines say which way to go from the village.

fen_collars.accept_text: The packmasters keep to Cur's Grave, east of the village along the east road. Cut the strap, and don't touch the studs.

fen_manor_guards.accept_text: Go north up the island road to Fenris Proper. The footmen walk the manor forecourt, and the guardians hold the walls either side of the gate.

fen_manor_hounds.accept_text: Head north up the island road to Fenris Proper and clear the grounds around the manor, east and west of the forecourt. Take the hounds and the keepers both.

fen_baron_ashbury.accept_text: He's in the manor at Fenris Proper, north up the island road and past the forecourt. Dress for a funeral.

fen_altar_cultists.accept_text: Shadowpine Altar is north-west of the village, down through the arch in the ridge. The cultists cast and the bonewalkers shield them, so take the casters first.

fen_altar_tael.accept_text: Go north-west to Shadowpine Altar, then east through its caverns to the Moon Circle. And don't watch the moonstone.

fen_altar_moonhowl.accept_text: It's north-west of here, through the arch in the ridge and down into Shadowpine Altar. The worgen and the wraiths hold its circles and the long roads between, and the fangs come off the worgen.

fen_altar_fenris.accept_text: Go north-west to Shadowpine Altar, then up to the Altar Ring at the top of the long climb. Take whichever road you like. They all end at his door.
